idea_coverage.mechanism: Target-normalized path/loop incidence, exact coverage/runs counts and m3 dependency extension.

literal_source_prediction.metric: M1 -- baseline slices B = 1 and B = n on every curve
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: FORCED, exact rational 1/n and 1; any deviation voids the implementation.

thresholds.controls: B1/Bn exact rational and point-graph boundaries

literal_source_prediction.metric: M2 -- random-arm average coverage over 200 random bases per cell, all default m = 2 ladder cells at 8, 10, 12, 16 bits, versus 1 - C(n - B, B)/C(n, B)
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: PREDICTED EQUALITY within 3 Monte Carlo standard errors on every cell (the SE of the mean over 200 bases at coverage 0.03 is about 0.002). Any cell outside 4 SE, replicated on a second seed, refutes Theorem 2 or the sampler and is the headline either way.

thresholds.controls: 200 bases per cell/seed, paired cyclic and uniform sampler controls

literal_source_prediction.metric: M3 -- residual of the protocol's reported curve HEUR-SEMAEV-2015-4.3 against the exact law, per cell
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Forced ratio exact/reported tending to 2^m = 4 at small B (0.0308 vs 0.0078 at N = 4099, B = 8), consistent with H-RELN-96e3ba; stated here as a computed table, not a measurement.

thresholds.controls: Exact/reported formula ratio, four N4099 anchors

literal_source_prediction.metric: M4 -- histogram of c(R) over random bases versus the runs law of Corollary 2d
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Chi-square against the closed form not rejected at 1 percent on cells with expected counts >= 5 in three bins; rejection at a replicated cell refutes Corollary 2d.

thresholds.controls: Exact PMF and source runs formula; targetP independent-base chi-square alpha.01

literal_source_prediction.metric: M5 -- planted AP-in-logs base coverage and its q-decay
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: At q = 0 coverage <= (4B + 1)/N, at least a factor 3 below the law at every cell with B >= 8; monotone rise in q with equality at q = 1 within 3 SE. Otherwise the instrument is blind to structure.

thresholds.controls: AP five-q ladder, literal bound/factor3/monotonicity and random endpoint

literal_source_prediction.metric: M6 -- m = 3 cells against the Janson bracket
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Empirical P[no decomposition] inside [exp(-mu_3/(1 - p_max)), exp(-mu_3 + Delta_3/2)] on every cell; a value outside the bracket replicated across seeds refutes HEUR-1 as stated.

thresholds.controls: All12 m3 cells,20 targets,200 bases; fixed-B source bracket and separate Bernoulli theorem control

idea_coverage.additional_heuristic_coverage: 20 m3 targets;10000-draw sampler audit; smallest no-hit tail
idea_coverage.interpretation_changes: Fixed-B Janson and3-uniform claims tested as hypotheses; repeated-class solutions retained. AP failure does not automatically invalidate.

idea_coverage.mechanism: Uniform signed-point multisets, exact inverse-fibre/energy identities and charged unique-split MITM count.

literal_source_prediction.metric: M1 -- baseline slice S = C_tot (all multisets) and m = 1
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: FORCED, exact integer agreement with |mW|/N; any deviation voids the counting oracle.

thresholds.controls: Deterministic full census,m1 and independent multiset/counting bijection

literal_source_prediction.metric: M2 -- hat_cov versus exact enumeration on all default m = 2 and m = 3 toy cells, S = 400 per base, 20 random bases per cell
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: PREDICTED EQUALITY within 3 SE on every cell; a bias replicated across bases and seeds at any cell refutes identity (i) as implemented.

thresholds.controls: All32 toy cells,20 bases,S400,two seeds; exact census and paired cyclic control

literal_source_prediction.metric: M3 -- empirical law of c_M - 1 on random bases versus Poisson(mu) (m = 2 exact via the runs law; m = 3 approximate)
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Chi-square not rejected at 1 percent at m = 2 on cells with three bins of expected count >= 5; at m = 3 a tail excess of more than 2x the Poisson mass at c >= 3 replicated across seeds is reported as structure, not as instrument failure.

thresholds.controls: Literal Poisson alpha.01 and m3twofold tail; separate size-biased finite law with O atom

literal_source_prediction.metric: M4 -- variance-per-cost ratio of the sampled-target estimator to this estimator, same cells, same oracle
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Ratio within a factor 2 of 4/mu^2 on cells with mu <= 0.2; a ratio below 1 at any such cell refutes the cost model.

thresholds.controls: Same400 oracle calls, uniform full-group target baseline, exact toy variance and coordinatewise setup/query cost

literal_source_prediction.metric: M5 -- planted AP arm energy and coverage with q-decay
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Energy >= 10x random at q = 0 for B >= 8, monotone decay in q, equality with the random law at q = 1 within 3 SE.

thresholds.controls: Five q values,10x energy, monotonicity and3SE random endpoint; extension uncertainty explicit

idea_coverage.additional_heuristic_coverage: Largest multiplicity at1/S Poisson tail; actual per-coordinate count costs;18 extension cells without census gate
idea_coverage.interpretation_changes: Poisson is not exact size bias; O remains primary. Extension has no exact coverage truth.

idea_coverage.mechanism: Actual EC Cayley walk, complete Fourier weights and spectrum, separate killed-chain law and real reconstructed rows.

literal_source_prediction.metric: M1 -- exact lambda_2 of Cay(Z/N, log W) for random bases versus sqrt(ln(N/2)/B), all default cells
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Within a factor 1.3 of the prediction on 90 percent of 50 random bases per cell (the maximum of Gaussians has relative spread of order 1/ln N); a systematic factor above 1.5 refutes HEUR-1 at that cell.

thresholds.controls: 50 bases,20main+3anchor cells;90%within1.3 and systematic factor1.5;8-bit caveat

literal_source_prediction.metric: M2 -- measured rho(k), k in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, of the walk's hit process versus the exact spectral formula, per cell
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: PREDICTED EQUALITY within 3 SE over 10^5 walk steps per cell; a departure replicated across seeds while NULL-A agrees is outcome (c) and voids the curve arm.

thresholds.controls: 100000steps,lags1/2/4/8/16, certified dependency-aware3SE, exactZ101 and paired cyclic controls

literal_source_prediction.metric: M3 -- hitting-time law of the walk versus geometric(cov), per cell
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: At (4099, B = 8, m = 2): variance-to-mean ratio of the hitting time at least 2x the geometric value (pre-registered from the spectral prediction; the exact factor is written per cell before the run). At (4099, B = 48) and (65537, B = 48): within 1.2x. A cell at B = 8 with ratio below 1.3x refutes the record's headline.

thresholds.controls: Certified forward moments,1000 restarts, original2x/1.3/1.2 anchors; separatePalm/Kac controls

literal_source_prediction.metric: M4 -- planted AP arm rho(k) and its q-decay
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: rho(16) >= 0.9 at q = 0 and lambda_2 monotone in q reaching the random value at q = 1 within a factor 1.3; otherwise the instrument is blind.

literal_source_prediction.metric: M5 -- mean row weight of the walk's relations per cell versus m + 1/cov
literal_source_prediction.minimum_effect: Within a factor 1.5 of m + 1/cov for the IID cells and above it for the non-mixing cells (droughts lengthen segments); a mean below m is impossible and voids the collector.

thresholds.controls: Actual first/pure rows, occurrences/sparse support; literalm+1/p factor1.5 and belowm assertions

idea_coverage.additional_heuristic_coverage: Full Gaussian-maximum CDF/tail; coefficient KS and halfwalk covariance; actual relation definitions
idea_coverage.interpretation_changes: Source initial-law/row-weight ambiguity fixed as stationary forward headline plus separate Palm/outside/actual row measures; original thresholds retained.
